scenes.hook: H T M L Paragraphs. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: A paragraph element groups a piece of text into a paragraph. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Wrap each paragraph in opening and closing P tags. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Browsers normally leave space between paragraphs. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Extra spaces and line breaks in source code usually collapse. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Write two paragraphs about something you enjoy. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
